SELECT PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECID, PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECNAME, PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECFULLNAME, PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECCODE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.MARKET, PAYHSRCSECINFO.INSTITUTION, PAYHSRCSECINFO.ISSUEPRICE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.PUBENDDATE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.VDATE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.MDATE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.ISSUEAMT, CUSTOMER_INFO1.CUSTOMER_NAME issuerName, PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECTYPE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECTYPE2, CASE PAYHSRCSECINFO.ISSUETYPE WHEN '01' THEN '1' ELSE '2' END AS ISSUETYPE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.BLNAREA, PAYHSRCSECINFO.ISSUS, PAYHSRCSECINFO.ISSECBOND, PAYHSRCSECINFO.CITY_INVEST_SEC_CHB CITYINVESTSECWIND, PAYHSRCSECINFO.CCY, PAYHSRCSECINFO.FACEVALUE, CUSTOMER_INFO2.CUSTOMER_NAME WARRANTOR, PAYHSRCSECINFO.GUARTYPE, CASE
WHEN ( PAYHSRCSECINFO.CALLOPTION = 'Y' OR PAYHSRCSECINFO.PUTOPTION = 'Y' ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS IS_RIGHT, PAYHSRCSECINFO.REMARK, PAYHSRCSECINFO.COUPONSPECIES, PAYHSRCSECINFO.INTERESTRATE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.PAPERIR, PAYHSRCSECINFO.SPREADRATE_8 SPREADRATE8, PAYHSRCSECINFO.RATECODE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.COEFFICIENT, PAYHSRCSECINFO.TOPRATE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.BOTTOMRATE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.RESETTYPE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.OBSERVEBEFDAY, PAYHSRCSECINFO.OBSERVEBEFUNIT, CASE
WHEN ( PAYHSRCSECINFO.RATEBASIC = 'A/A_B_COUP' OR PAYHSRCSECINFO.PUTOPTION = 'A_B_DAY' ) THEN 'A/A' ELSE PAYHSRCSECINFO.RATEBASIC END AS RATEBASIC, CASE
WHEN PAYHSRCSECINFO.RATEBASIC = 'A/A_B_COUP' THEN '02' WHEN PAYHSRCSECINFO.RATEBASIC = 'A/A_B_DAY' THEN '01' END AS BASISSTYLE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.WORKDAYRULE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.PAYCYCLE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.SCHECALRULE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.FIRSTRATEDAY FROM INTERF_PAYHSRCSECINFO PAYHSRCSECINFO LEFT JOIN INTERF_CUSTOMER_INFO CUSTOMER_INFO1 ON PAYHSRCSECINFO.ISSUERSHORT = CUSTOMER_INFO1.CUSTOMER_ID LEFT JOIN INTERF_CUSTOMER_INFO CUSTOMER_INFO2 ON CUSTOMER_INFO1.CUSTOMER_ID = PAYHSRCSECINFO.GUARANTOR LEFT JOIN INTERF_PAYHSRCSECOPTION PAYHSRCSECOPTION ON PAYHSRCSECOPTION.SECID = PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECID LEFT JOIN INTERF_PAYHSRCSECRATING PAYHSRCSECRATING ON PAYHSRCSECRATING.SECID = PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECID AND PAYHSRCSECRATING.ratingtype = 'C' LEFT JOIN INTERF_PAYHSRCSECRATING PAYHSRCSECRATING2 ON PAYHSRCSECRATING2.SECID = PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECID AND PAYHSRCSECRATING2.ratingtype = 'I'
PAYHSRCSECINFO.VDATE <= to_date ( #{iplatformDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD' )
AND PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECID = #{secId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select SECID, OPTIONSTARTDAY, OPTIONENDDAY, OPTIONPAYDAY, THEORYOPTIONPAYDAY, OPTIONPRICE, OPTIONTYPE, OPTIONCLAUSE, '01' OPTIONSTATUS from INTERF_PAYHSRCSECOPTION where SECID = #{secId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY THEORYOPTIONPAYDAY ASC

SELECT PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECID, PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECNAME, PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECFULLNAME, PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECCODE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.MARKET, PAYHSRCSECINFO.INSTITUTION, PAYHSRCSECINFO.INSTITUTIONTEXT, PAYHSRCSECINFO.ISSUEPRICE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.PUBENDDATE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.VDATE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.MDATE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.DELISTING_DATE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.CALLOPTION, PAYHSRCSECINFO.PUTOPTION, MARKET_INFO.MARKET_AMT, MARKET_INFO.VALUE_DATE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.ISSUEAMT, PAYHSRCSECINFO.ISSUERSHORT ISSUERNAME, TYPE_CONFIG.INPUT_VALUE_2 SECTYPE, TYPE_CONFIG.INPUT_VALUE_3 SECTYPE2, TYPE_CONFIG.INPUT_VALUE_4 SECTYPE3, CASE PAYHSRCSECINFO.ISSUETYPE WHEN '01' THEN '1' ELSE '2' END AS ISSUETYPE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.ISSUS, CASE
WHEN ( PAYHSRCSECINFO.CALLOPTION = 'Y' OR PAYHSRCSECINFO.PUTOPTION = 'Y' ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS ISRIGHT, 'Y' ISAUTOUPDATE, -- PAYHSRCSECINFO.是否净价交易, PAYHSRCSECINFO.CCY, PAYHSRCSECINFO.CITY_INVEST_SEC_CHB, PAYHSRCSECINFO.IS_GREEN_BOND, PAYHSRCSECINFO.ISSECBOND, PAYHSRCSECINFO.CROSS_MARKET_CODE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.REMARK, --转债信息 -- PAYHSRCSECINFO.正股代码, PRODUCT.FINPROD_ABBR SHARENAME, -- PAYHSRCSECINFO.转股起始日, -- PAYHSRCSECINFO.转股价格, -- PAYHSRCSECINFO.回售触发价, -- PAYHSRCSECINFO.赎回触发价, --计息要素 PAYHSRCSECINFO.COUPONSPECIES, PAYHSRCSECINFO.INTERESTRATE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.PAPERIR, PAYHSRCSECINFO.BASE_RATE_ACCURACY, PAYHSRCSECINFO.RATECODE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.COEFFICIENT, PAYHSRCSECINFO.SPREADRATE_8 SPREADRATE8, PAYHSRCSECINFO.TOPRATE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.BOTTOMRATE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.RESETTYPE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.OBSERVEBEFDAY, PAYHSRCSECINFO.OBSERVEBEFUNIT, PAYHSRCSECINFO.FIRST_RATE_DETERMINATION_DATE, CASE
WHEN PAYHSRCSECINFO.RATEBASIC = 'A/365' THEN 'A/365' WHEN PAYHSRCSECINFO.RATEBASIC = 'A/360' THEN 'A/360' WHEN PAYHSRCSECINFO.RATEBASIC = 'A/365F' THEN 'A/365F' WHEN PAYHSRCSECINFO.RATEBASIC = '30/360' THEN '30/360' WHEN ( PAYHSRCSECINFO.RATEBASIC = 'A/A_B_COUP' OR PAYHSRCSECINFO.RATEBASIC = 'A/A_B_DAY' ) THEN 'A/A' ELSE NULL END AS RATEBASIC, CASE
WHEN PAYHSRCSECINFO.RATEBASIC = 'A/A_B_COUP' THEN '平均分配' WHEN PAYHSRCSECINFO.RATEBASIC = 'A/A_B_DAY' THEN '按实际天数分配' ELSE NULL END AS BASICSTYLE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.FIRSTRATEDAY, PAYHSRCSECINFO.SCHECALRULE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.PAYCYCLE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.WORKDAYRULE, PAYHSRCSECINFO.REMARK FROM INTERF_PAYHSRCSECINFO PAYHSRCSECINFO LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT PRODUCT ON PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = PAYHSRCSECINFO.CROSS_MARKET_CODE AND PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F10' LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE_CONFIG TYPE_CONFIG on PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECTYPE = TYPE_CONFIG.OUTPUT_VALUE_1 AND (TYPE_CONFIG.OUTPUT_VALUE_2 is null or PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECTYPE2 = TYPE_CONFIG.OUTPUT_VALUE_2) AND TYPE_CONFIG.CONFIG_TYPE = 'WINDTWO_TG_TYPE' LEFT JOIN MST_BOND_MARKET_INFO MARKET_INFO ON MARKET_INFO.SEC_ID = PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECID AND MARKET_INFO.VALUE_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{platformDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') WHERE PAYHSRCSECINFO.SECID = #{secId, jdbcType = VARCHAR}
